about.title: Solana Beach Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Solana Beach is a small city — about 13,449 people along the coast in San Diego County — and when a family here loses someone suddenly, the loss ripples through neighbors, schools and workplaces. In 2025, the city's public collision record shows 49 injury crashes and 72 people hurt, with no traffic fatalities recorded that year. That is genuinely good news, but wrongful death claims are not limited to the road. They can grow out of a fall on someone's property, a defective product, medical neglect, or a crash on I-5 or Lomas Santa Fe Drive. Under California law, the right to bring a wrongful death claim belongs first to a spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and shorter if a government entity is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We connect you, free of charge, with an independent attorney who works on contingency and can talk through your family's situation with care.

whyChoose.title: Why Solana Beach Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who may file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can tell you quickly whether you or another family member is the right person to bring the claim.

items.title: The two-year clock, explained
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county or state agency is involved. Connecting early means nothing is lost to a missed deadline.

items.title: Recovery that reflects the whole loss
items.desc: California allows families to seek funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. A contingency attorney pursues all of it, with no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My relative was killed in a crash on I-5 near Solana Beach. Does a state highway change anything?
items.answer: It can. When a public agency such as a state or county road authority may share responsibility, California requires a formal claim to that agency first, and the deadline is much shorter than the standard two years. An independent attorney can review the collision report and sort out whether a government claim is needed alongside any claim against a driver.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death case is a civil action and runs separately from any criminal prosecution. The criminal court decides punishment; the civil case addresses your family's losses. Waiting for the criminal case to finish does not pause your two-year filing deadline, so it is wise to speak with an attorney sooner rather than later.

items.question: How does LawProactive work, and what does it cost our family?
